metadata.title: जंगल में हुई जबरदस्त मटन दावत | Mutton Feast with Bhil Adivasis | Tribal Kitchen Exclusive
metadata.description:
Nestled in the lush green hills of Ratlam district, Ramgarh Borakheda is a serene tribal hamlet inhabited by the Bhil Adivasis of Madhya Pradesh. During the monsoon, the village transforms into a breathtaking landscape of greenery and life.

In this exclusive episode of The Tribal Kitchen, the Main Bhi Bharat team travels deep into this remote village to experience the warmth and hospitality of the Bhil community. Join us as we cook and share a hearty mutton feast, learn about their food culture, and celebrate the monsoon spirit with the villagers.

This episode captures not just the culinary richness of the Bhil tribe but also the deep bond they share with their land, nature, and community.
#mutton #tribalfeast #food
